description: This file defines controller functions for managing credentials in an Express.js application, including create, delete, retrieve, and update operations.

methods.name: createCredential
methods.description: Handles creation of a new credential, validating request body and workspace ID.

methods.name: deleteCredentials
methods.description: Deletes a credential by ID within the user's active workspace.

methods.name: getAllCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials for the user's active workspace, optionally filtered by credential name.

methods.name: getCredentialById
methods.description: Fetches a specific credential by ID within the user's active workspace.

methods.name: updateCredential
methods.description: Updates an existing credential identified by ID within the user's active workspace.
